description: START HERE for any question about funds. Search actively deploying venture capital funds by stage, country and industry. COST: free, and it works with no API key at all. Returns name, slug, country, stage, fund size, industries and a durable profile URL. The `slug` in each result is what every other tool takes as input, so run this first and copy the slug rather than constructing one from a fund's name.

country.description: Country of the fund's headquarters, spelled out in full (e.g. 'United States', 'United Kingdom', 'Germany'). Not an ISO code.

industry.description: Industry focus. Must be one of the listed enum values (lowercase, underscores), e.g. 'ai_ml', 'fintech', 'climate_sustainability'. Common spellings such as 'AI/ML', 'FinTech' or 'climate' are accepted and normalised.

stage.description: Funding stage focus. Must be one of the listed enum values (lowercase, underscores). Common spellings such as 'Pre-Seed' or 'Series A' are accepted and normalised.

name: search_funds
title: Search VC funds
